overview: Once Human has no fixed 'class' system — instead your playstyle is defined by which Weapon Effect (the combat archetype tied to your weapons/mods) and Memetic Specialization branch you build around. These act as the closest equivalent to classes.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Shrapnel
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Bullets fragment for extra per-part damage; considered a top pick for melting the Great Ones and general PvE.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Power Surge
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Dump full magazines to build stacking Electric/Shock damage; capable of ~100,000 DPS in optimized PvE builds.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Frost Vortex
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Creates damaging vortexes that also return health, excellent against big single targets while keeping you alive.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Bounce
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Projectiles ricochet between enemies; shines in corridors or dense enemy groups.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Fast Gunner
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Rewards continuous firing and weapon-switching with stacking damage/reload buffs; pairs best with high-magazine LMGs like the MG4 Predator.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Burn
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Stacking burn DoT that snowballs with mods that preserve or extend stacks on kill.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Unstable Bomber
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Builds toward bomb-like detonations, scaling well with Crit Rate.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Fortress Warfare
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Buffs tied to structures and holding ground, strengthened by nearby teammates.

weaponEffectArchetypes.name: Marked / Bull's Eye
weaponEffectArchetypes.summary: Marks targets to amplify incoming damage from the whole team.

memeticBranches.name: Gathering
memeticBranches.focus: Improves the yield of materials collected in the wild (ore, wood, water, crystals).

memeticBranches.name: Crafting
memeticBranches.focus: Upgrades workbenches and unlocks new craftable items, weapons and gadgets.

memeticBranches.name: Management
memeticBranches.focus: Survival-oriented upgrades: generators, cooking, temperature control, farming infrastructure.

memeticBranches.name: Building
memeticBranches.focus: Improves crafting/production facilities, defensive structures, turrets, traps and territory tools.

note: Every 5 levels starting at level 5, players unlock a Memetic Specialization node offering a choice of 4 randomly generated specializations (one per branch), for up to 10 chosen specializations by level 50. See blueprints.json / builds.json for how these tie into gear and loadouts.
